diagnosis: The check C4 passed in all four rollouts because the model defaulted to assigning each role to a unique individual, which aligns with the equal-split heuristic. This heuristic ensures that each role is assigned to a different person, regardless of the hidden information provided by PF1, PF2, and PF3.
fix_instructions: Tighten check C4 to require that the assignments must be based on the revealed qualifications (PF1, PF2, PF3) rather than the default equal-split heuristic. Specifically, modify the check to ensure that the model cannot assign roles without considering the provided qualifications.
